title: Ledup values accordion
description: A dark brown card with 20px corners holding a stack of numbered rows (01. Innovation … 05.), each a shade lighter than the one above and tucked under it like filing tabs. The open row shows a title, a short paragraph and photos (one on phones, two staggered on desktop) above its label; clicking another row slides it open (0.5s) and folds the others. On phones the card is 88% of the window tall.
notes: drawn with bg-foreground and text-background: a dark band on light themes, a pale one on dark themes; the rows step toward the background colour
each item takes two photos (the second shows on desktop only); empty shows translucent placeholders
needs JavaScript to switch rows (hydrate: visible); the first item is open in the static HTML
name: ledup-values
